UPDATE time_slots slot SET status = 'LOCKED' WHERE slot.status IN ('AVAILABLE', 'BOOKED') AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM bookings booking WHERE booking.venue_court_id = slot.venue_court_id AND booking.play_date = slot.date AND booking.start_time = slot.start_time AND booking.end_time = slot.end_time AND booking.status = 'PENDING_PAYMENT' );
UPDATE time_slots slot SET status = 'BOOKED' WHERE slot.status IN ('AVAILABLE', 'LOCKED') AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM bookings booking WHERE booking.venue_court_id = slot.venue_court_id AND booking.play_date = slot.date AND booking.start_time = slot.start_time AND booking.end_time = slot.end_time AND booking.status IN ('CONFIRMED', 'CHECKED_IN', 'COMPLETED') );
